title: First run: food and drink, metal and gear
summary: Both trial chains sit on the curve: Cooking and Smithing each reach 99 in 15.2 to 15.3 days for an optimized player (the curve says 15.3) and about 28 days for a typical one, with no empty stretches in either. The run fixed three slips in the page's own sums, and the owner approved two rule changes the same day.
checked: Cooking: 99 recipes, one per level from 1 to 99. No level is more than 15 % off the curve, and every new recipe pays more than the one before. No empty stretches.
Smithing: 77 recipes. No level is more than 15 % off the curve, and every new recipe pays more than the one before. No empty stretches; the longest run with nothing new is 5 levels (93 to 98).
Every ingredient arrives in time: the worst wait is a new metal's ingot waiting about 20 minutes on its ore, far inside the wall rule.
Gathering behind the work: a darkmetal Chestplate needs about 10 minutes of gathering for 69 seconds at the anvil, in line with the rules' 9 gatherers per crafter at darkmetal with no boosts.
Not checked yet: the ledger's own timing. The ledger read-out isn't built and the plan isn't in the CMS, so these are the page's numbers only.
moved: Fixed: late food was costed like armour. A Voidcap Pie took 3 Dough (the page read cap), a Harvest Platter 5 Bread (vest), Swordfish in Sofrito 2 Sofrito (sword). Food, drinks and potions now always take 1 of a made ingredient.
Fixed: Water is 1 in every recipe, as the rules say. Late soups and teas were asking for 3 to 5 Water.

Fixed: an unlock no longer moves below the level of an ingredient from another skill. Elixir of Ironskin stays at 8 (it had moved to 6, below its Clay), and four arrows stay with their arrowheads. This brings back an empty stretch at Alchemy 2 to 7 and two short ones in Fletching, for week 2.

Adjusted, inside the limits: action lengths are trimmed by up to 15 % so whole XP pays the rule's XP an hour exactly. A Copper Ingot is 8.9 s for 3 XP (was 8.1 s), a Copper Dagger 11.5 s for 4 XP (was 12.2 s). Early recipes no longer pay unevenly from rounding.
Unlock moves in the two chains: Copper Chestplate 13 to 16 and Adamantine Chestplate 73 to 76, each to break up a long run with nothing new before the next metal.

Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: the optimized player's boosts climb level by level between tiers instead of stepping up at each one. A new tier's first recipes used to pay up to 17 % less than the old tier's last (Coconut Pie at 80 against Coconut Swordfish at 79); now none does.

Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: gear takes 50 % longer for each bar past the first, up from 20 %. A Chestplate takes 3x a Dagger (40 s at copper, 69 s at darkmetal) and a bar spent on Daggers earns 1.7x a bar spent on Chestplates, down from 2.8x.

Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: a recipe with a made base (a stew on Sofrito, a potion on a Draught, a pie on Dough) takes 1 of each raw ingredient at every level. The page already worked this way; the rules page now says so.
gaps: The other skills' stretches are still the solver's raw list, to be reviewed in week 2: docs/active/balance_gaps.md.
waiting: On the director: the ledger read-out and the ledger's new tiers and boost budget (brief 880, L1 to L3). Until then the page can't be checked against the engine.
On the content session: the plan in the CMS as Planned entries. No number pack before that.
On the balancer, next run: how many Nails, Arrowheads and Kunai one bar makes, and how long a drink's dose lasts. No rule sets these yet, so the page shows them as 1 a craft.
The rules page's metal and Bread examples are regenerated from the solver. Its XP table and boost budget are unchanged.
